conditions: Adequate signage must be provided to ensure safety of vehicles entering and exiting the lot.
Parking layout must comply with the required 25-ft access lane width in the Town Code.
Pedestrian striping must be provided along the walkway portion of the parking area.
The parking area must be properly illuminated at night.
An easement or property boundary modification must be obtained for the pull-off area, which encroaches on the adjacent parcel (both parcels currently owned by the same owner).
